items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: The interviewee discusses Lee Collins' wives, confirming the interviewer's identification of 'Mary' as Lee Collins' last wife, but provides no personal interaction or relationship with Mary herself.

ctx.x: No, René used to teach shawky. You see, Lee Collins, Lee Collins was playing up there after Lewis and them left at the Beverly Gardens up there and Lee Collins and Earl Humphrey and all of them used to play together. He used to live down there in Belmont Place, let me tell you a joke about Earl Humphrey and Lee Collins and they left a dance one night, the Beverly Gardens didn't go on, you know the dance didn't go on, they come home. Well they wise, they had two guys entertain them, serenading, drinking wine and…
Can't think of, well the one in Chicago was Mary, wasn't it? That was his last wife.

Yeah. But he had a wife before her, Lillian. Lillian was the wife, Lillian. That was the last, that's the woman who looked out for him, she used to book him when he was down there at Paddock, I believe.
